APCTT-C01.quote: represents hydrodynamic surface-water flow and three-dimensional groundwater conditions and accounts for leakage between surface-water and groundwater parts of the system
APCTT-C01.note: Physical basis of the coupled density-dependent simulator (FTLOADDS), with citations.

APCTT-C02.quote: model was developed by the U.S. Geological Survey under the Greater Everglades Priority Ecosystem Studies Initiative to evaluate, both separately and in conjunction, the likely effects on surface-water stages and flows, hydroperiod, and groundwater levels and salinity in south Florida
APCTT-C02.note: Application: evaluating barriers, water management and sea-level rise; potential applications listed (p33).

APCTT-C03.quote: Sea-level change has a more pronounced effect on hydrology than does CERP restoration.

APCTT-C05.quote: The BISECT model was calibrated to (1) measured flow, stage, and salinity for free-flowing streams discharging to coastal waters; (2) daily groundwater levels in the Biscayne aquifer; (3) wetland water levels; and (4) the general location of the saltwater-freshwater mixing zone in the Biscayne aquifer.
APCTT-C05.note: Calibration against field networks of the study area (details in appendix 1).

APCTT-C06.quote: Scenarios that simulate climatic and anthropogenic changes yielded substantial insight into the hydrology in the BISECT model area, which includes about 7,300 square kilometers of the south Florida peninsula and about 2,700 square kilometers of the surrounding tidal water bodies (Atlantic Ocean, Gulf of Mexico, and Florida Bay).
APCTT-C06.note: Calibrated model applied to barrier, restoration and sea-level-rise scenarios.

APCTT-C07.note: Potential applications are listed, but no operational use.

APCTT-C10.note: Mass-balance errors under 1 percent are reported, but no requirement is stated.

APCTT-C11.quote: The BISECT model represents and is calibrated to conditions during the 9-year period from January 1, 1996, through December 31, 2004.
APCTT-C11.note: Base-case period, domain and refinements (p34) defined.

APCTT-C12.quote: model was developed by the U.S. Geological Survey under the Greater Everglades Priority Ecosystem Studies Initiative to evaluate, both separately and in conjunction, the likely effects on surface-water stages and flows, hydroperiod, and groundwater levels and salinity in south Florida
APCTT-C12.note: Evidence concerns the BISECT model itself.

notes: Agrees with the organizer estimate TRL 6.
